items.title: Harry Fairconnetue Interview, 1962-11-11
items.q: Then we went on a tour with him.

ctx.x: I wonder what he was doing in New Orleans.

Well, I think he came to Xavier to teach, I think. Uh-huh. I think so. And, uh, well, late on he married Dr. Thornhill's daughter. I think he came to Xavier to teach or some study or something. I don't know. I wouldn't know that part. Yeah, but I'm almost positive. He came to me out there. Then we went on a tour with him. Uh-huh. We stayed six months, you know? Yeah, on that one trip. Yeah, on that one trip. Went all through, we was booking out from Omaha. Yeah, when we left here, we went through Arkansas, Texas.…
How long is this table, 18 feet would you say?
